-- Called by; startSearch (row 62)
param tab:integer,word:string,str:string -> integer
var score:integer
switch tab -- column of ExampleTab
-- case 2
	-- score += 1 -- column 'Name of the frame': like .Models.Container.WorkpieceCarrier (name of the obj file is not a good characteristic for the example)
case 4
	score += 10 -- column 'key words'
case 5
	score += 15+CountOccur(word,str,5) -- TitleENU
case 6
	score += 15+CountOccur(word,str,6) -- TitleDEU
case 7
	score += 10+CountOccur(word,str,7) -- DescriptionENU
case 8
	score += 10+CountOccur(word,str,8) -- DescriptionDEU
end

return score
